data.body: Consideration: [Implicit shared state] strata-detection.env facts artifact is consumed by S4 (config-writes), S5 (arch-enforcement), S10 (A0 wiring), and S11 (completion-verifier). Pin its schema explicitly: version field, field names (STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND, STRATA_COMMIT_PIN, STRATA_SRC_PATH, STRATA_DETECTION_SOURCE), sub-stack enum values, and unset/empty semantics. Document the schema in plugins/dso/scripts/detect-strata.sh header AND DETECTION-SCHEMA.md so the four consumers cannot key off divergent shapes.
